name: Meatloaf I
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Combine the ground beef, eggs, minced garlic, salt, allspice, curry powder, and Worcestershire sauce.
Mix in the chopped onion, celery, and cracker crumbs.
Press the mixture into a standard loaf pan.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for about 10–20 minutes until browned on top.
Tilt the pan, and drain off any accumulated grease. Add the mushroom soup on top.
Bake another 1.5–2 hours until cooked through.
